//: Runs `dotnet test` in Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode rather than VSTest mode.
Required, not preference: Microsoft.Testing.Platform 2.x - which xunit.v3 4.x brings in -
refuses to run under the VSTest target at all on the .NET 10 SDK. Without this, every test
run fails with 'Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported'.
It has to be here. The TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport property in the test project was the
.NET 9 opt-in and is ignored by MTP 2.x; the SDK reads the runner choice from global.json
What this changes for callers: the VSTest-only switches are gone. Use --report-trx in place
of --logger trx, --results-directory is replaced by --results-directory on the runner itself,
--filter-method in place of --filter, and pass a project with --project rather than
positionally. No extra -- separator is needed.
No sdk section on purpose: pinning an SDK version here would make every machine and runner
that does not have that exact band fail to build at all.
